title: Pink Punk Hammer Girl
description: Four-panel sequence showing a pink-haired punk girl in various dynamic poses with a massive purple hammer. She wears a pink and black outfit with boots and fishnets. The panels depict her wielding the hammer with purple lightning, swinging it, smashing it into the ground with green energy burst, and standing beside it.
prompt: Four panel comic sequence on dark grey background featuring the same pink-haired punk girl with long flowing hair. She wears a pink cropped jacket, black shorts, fishnets, and green boots. In the first panel she holds a giant purple and black hammer with glowing purple lightning effects. Second panel shows her mid-swing with motion trails. Third panel depicts her smashing the hammer down creating a bright green and purple starburst explosion. Final panel shows her standing confidently beside the resting hammer. Bold cel-shaded comic art style with vibrant colors and dynamic action.
